70tommy_inline void tommy_array_grow(tommy_array* array, tommy_size_t size)
71{
72 if (size > array->count) {
73 array->count = size;
74
75 if (size > array->bucket_max)
76 tommy_array_reserve(array, size);

116tommy_inline void** tommy_array_ref(tommy_array* array, tommy_size_t pos)
117{
118 assert(pos < array->count);
119
120 /* get the highest bit set, in case of all 0, return 0 */
121 tommy_uint_t bsr = tommy_ilog2(pos | 1);
122
123 return &array->bucket[bsr][pos];
124}

169tommy_inline void tommy_array_insert_tail(tommy_array* array, void* element)
170{
171 tommy_size_t pos = array->count;
172
173 ++array->count;
174 if (array->count > array->bucket_max)
175 tommy_array_reserve(array, array->count);
176
177 tommy_array_set(array, pos, element);
178}
179
187tommy_inline void* tommy_array_remove_tail(tommy_array* array)
188{
189 assert(array->count != 0);
190
191 tommy_size_t pos = array->count - 1;
192 void** ptr = tommy_array_ref(array, pos);
193 void* element = *ptr;
194
195 /* keep unused slots zero so growing within capacity needs no initialization */
196 *ptr = 0;
197 array->count = pos;
198
199 return element;
200}
